observations.detail: Pages API reported status=errored, error=null, build_type=legacy, source=main:/ — while a live fetch of the site URL still returned the current dashboard (HTTP content present via fetch_page). Matches the transient instant-error pattern recorded in PRs #31 and #32.
Dashboard rendered: title 'Research overview · Own8', executive findings table, KPIs, links to pages/* all present.

diagnosis: The repository's GitHub Pages publication is the legacy main/root pipeline (build_type=legacy, source branch main path /). The API 'errored' state observed at session start was a transient build failure already known from PR #31/#32 records; it self-recovered when the next pushes to main triggered fresh builds. No settings change was made or needed (settings writes previously returned HTTP 403 for other sessions — see dd321bf5/566bc2e7 board entries — and none was attempted here).
result: HEALTHY — status built; six consecutive successful builds and deployments on 2026-11-14; live URL serves the current dashboard.
